findings: Neet has continuous full narrow torso, fine legs, four separate supported paws and broad triangular ears. Small rounded rump projection remains a tiny nub, not a developed tail. Cream muzzle and chest, dark rims and smooth fawn coat preserve identity.

Buddy is behind Heather with visible connected neck, substantial forelegs, hind support and elongated torso continuing behind her jeans. Human overlap accounts for hidden anatomy; no fused or stray limbs. Local ear/muzzle/brow furnishings remain distinct from smooth charcoal trunk.

Heather holds chai above dogs, monkey sits supported on parapet holding mango, fallen colorful cloth and overturned pot match the arrival state before can/broom action. Forward Neet versus cautious Buddy versus eating monkey gives a clear three-way comic contrast.

Floor perspective, contact shadows and parapet supports are coherent. No coat curls or expanded shag volume remain on either torso; image is clean at native 1536x1024. Human identity and setting architecture remain illustrative/provisional.

findings: Aftermath composition works: Buddy nuzzles Heather knee, Neet stands proudly amid broken pots, soil, cloth and discarded can; Heather holds grounded broom. No monkeys remain. This is the correct quiet state after retreat and before hug.

Both dogs have coherent spine/chest/pelvis and plausible support; Buddy far foreleg is occluded by Heather while near foreleg and both hind legs remain grounded. Neet four legs and near-flush nub are visible. Heather hands/legs and chair ownership are unambiguous.

Material finish defect: repeated curved etched strokes cover Buddy charcoal shoulder/ribcage/flank (approximately x380-690,y315-510), with directional raised hair at shoulder/upper legs.
